methodology:
MP Evans expanded from 4-row to 6-row breakdown to separate the East Kalimantan mature core (Bumi Mas estate + mill) from the new ABK expansion project (2025 immature planting). Aceh and Bangka-Belitung now also separated.

Cluster breakdown:
- North Sumatra (49.4K ac): most mature with multiple mills
- South Sumatra Musi Rawas (27.2K ac): 6th mill commissioned 2024
- Aceh (24.7K ac): smaller mature cluster
- Bangka-Belitung (24.7K ac): offshore Sumatra mining-rehabilitation
- East Kalimantan Bumi Mas mature (32K ac): primary KAL cluster
- East Kalimantan ABK expansion (17.4K ac): 2025 new planting at immature discount

USD-reporting + GBp-listing structure unchanged. Total ~175K planted acres = 70.9K hectares per MP Evans FY24 disclosure.
